title: MarkupAdvice
description: Advisory markup, overhead and volatility suggestions for a settlement draft, with reasoning. Pure data: it has no field that sets anything. Only a person sets the values, approval thresholds are enforced exactly as before, and every margin figure is computed by the platform from these percentages, never by the model.

options.description: Three project-level scenarios, from lower to higher price.

rationale.description: Why these percentages: the win/loss history, the risk in the flagged lines, the volatility setting, the project size.

per_trade.description: Optional ranges per trade where the trade's risk or history differs from the project as a whole.

trade.description: The trade name exactly as supplied.

overall.description: Two or three sentences summarising the advice and its main risk.
